claim: This criminal lawyer defended the Olympic Park Bomber, an American domestic terrorist convicted for a series of anti-abortion and anti-gay-motivated bombings across the southern United States. She was also the defense attorney in the Trial of Dzhokhar Tsarnaev.
evidencia:
Page: Judy Clarke. Sentence: She has negotiated plea agreements that spare her clients the death penalty, as was the case for Eric Rudolph, Ted Kaczynski, and Jared Lee Loughner.
Page: Eric Rudolph. Sentence: Eric Robert Rudolph (born September 19, 1966), also known as the Olympic Park Bomber, is an American domestic terrorist convicted for a series of anti-abortion and anti-gay-motivated bombings across the southern United States between 1996 and 1998, which killed two people and injured over 120 others.
Page: Trial of Dzhokhar Tsarnaev. Sentence: Tsarnaev's attorney, Judy Clarke, opened by telling the jurors that her client and his older brother, Tamerlan, planted a bomb killing three and injuring hundreds, as well as murdering a MIT police officer days later.
